title: Chicken and mushroom polenta
summary: Chicken and mushroom polenta is a italian dinner built around skinless chicken thigh fillets and chestnut mushrooms, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Warm the oil and soften the onion for Chicken and mushroom polenta. Stir in the garlic, ginger and spices until they smell fragrant.
steps.tip: If the spices look dusty, give them a minute in the oil before any liquid goes in.

steps.instruction: Add skinless chicken thigh fillets and cook until it loses its raw look. Pour in the tomatoes or coconut and chestnut mushrooms.
Simmer gently, lid ajar, until polenta is tender and the sauce coats a spoon. Add a splash of water if it sticks.
steps.tip: Taste Chicken and mushroom polenta before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Taste for salt and acid, then rest the pan for a couple of minutes before serving Chicken and mushroom polenta.  Serve with the polenta, simmered in salted water until tender.
